statements.text: Tom Reilly, a highly-decorated high school coach for over 30 years, was hired as the head women's soccer coach at Washington College in March 2017.
He quickly made his mark on the program as the Shorewomen went 7-9-1 in 2017, Reilly's first season, for their best-ever single-season winning percentage at that point.
